senses.gloss: m. (a corrupt. of ξέστης) ḳisṭ, ḳisṭa (Sixtarius), v. כְּסִיסְטָא.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> <he>חד ק׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="S01658"><he>קסיט</he></cite>) one xestes of wine (which you had) makes ten follera.

<cite ref="Pesachim 109a">Pes. 109ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ דמורייסא וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="S01685"><he>קסתא</he></cite>, Ms. M. <he>קיסתא</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the xestes for muries (kept as a standard) in Sepphoris was about the same as the Temple Log. Pesik. Ekhah, p. 122ᵇ <he>ק׳ דחמר</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="S01658"><he>קסיט</he></cite>) a. x. of wine; a. e.—Pl. <he>קִיסְטִין</he>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12:1">Lev. R. s. 12</cite> <he>שתי שיכרא חמשא ק׳</he> (not <he>קיסטון</he>) he (the drunkard) drinks five xestes of beer, they tell him, thou hadst ten.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12:1">Ib.</cite> <he>הוה אליף … ק׳ וכ׳</he> was accustomed to drink twelve x. of wine a day &c.; a. e.—[V. Fr. Aram. Fremdw. p. 205].
